item.title: Your Agents Ship Fast. Make Them Pass a Release Gate First
item.description: Before tagging ai-finance-coach 1.0.0, one command found my first name in a test, an employer in a test id and one of my own figures in the demo data, all in a repository with green CI. What leaks when agents work with real data, why CI and secret scanners can’t see it, and the generic recipe I use now - one scripted release gate, a local term file that never enters the repository, and four places that force everyone, agents included, to run it.

item.title: You Don't Need a Scion: Graft, a Review Layer for Agent Pull Requests
item.description: Anthropic’s Scion solves a storage problem only a few companies have. The workflow problem behind it, too many agent pull requests for the humans who review them, is everyone’s. Graft, now public, puts a checked intent card, a risk class no model can lower and a policy verdict on every pull request, so reviewers read the card before the diff. What ships in v0.0.1, how a reviewer’s day changes, the video, and what the live test checks.
